services.name: radar-track-a-staging

required_operator_bindings.DATABASE_URL: Private-network URL for isolated staging PostgreSQL; dedicated least-privilege runtime role
required_operator_bindings.PAY_SH_CATALOG_URL: Operator-approved live HTTPS catalog URL; never a fixture URL
required_operator_bindings.ADMIN_TOKEN: Unique staging-only token required by existing readiness dependency check; controlled profile still forbids admin writes

services.ingress: Restricted operator/tester access; no unrestricted public domain before access gate
services.mutation_profile: Only POST /v1/pre-spend/check and /v1/decide; existing 30/minute per-process shared bound

database.name: radar-track-a-postgres
database.version: Operator-pinned supported PostgreSQL version; local evidence is 14.20

migrations.apply: Operator-only one-off job using staging migration role after backup and approval; never automatic deploy DDL

secrets_policy: Only isolated staging DB/runtime and migration-role credentials and a unique staging admin token. No production credentials, signing keys, funded-wallet bindings, provider API keys, reviewer trust activation or launch policy.
rollback: Hold traffic; restore previous approved staging-only guarded image or stop service on first boot. Keep additive schema; restore to new database only after reviewed recovery and replay.
